							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>

                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally held on the third Tuesday of each month with the exception of January when no meeting is held.</p>
<p><a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/2026/council-meeting-dates-2026_1.pdf" target="_self" title="COUNCIL-MEETING-DATES-2026_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 7MB)</span></a></p>
<p>Business Papers will be available on Council's website and may also be inspected at Council’s office and in the Library from the Friday prior to each monthly meeting.</p>
<p>The Council Meetings are open to the public and members of the public are invited to address the Council on items of business to be considered at the meeting.</p>
<p>To speak at a public forum, a person must first make an application to the council in the approved form. Applications to speak at <span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">the public forum must be received by 12:00pm the day prior to the meeting on the date on which the public forum is to be held </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">and must identify the item of business on the agenda of the council meeting the person wishes to speak on, and whether they </span><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">wish to speak ‘for’ or ‘against’ the item.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">A person may apply to speak on no more than one (1) items of business on the agenda of the council meeting.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">View Council's <a href="/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes/public-forum-guidelines-2026.pdf" target="_self" title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-2026.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Public Forum Guidelines HERE<span class="file-info">(PDF, 134KB)</span></a></span></p>
<p>Video recordings of each Council meeting will be made available from Council’s website. </p>
<p>View Council's <a href="/c1aaa3b1-f397-4e67-967a-48cb59b0b7dd" target="_self" title="Model-Code-of-Meeting-Practice-Final.pdf">Code of Meeting Practice HERE</a></p>
<p>Council Minutes are published after being adopted by Council at the following meeting.</p>
<p>View Agendas, Minutes and supporting documents by clicking on the meeting date headings below</p>
